races.name: Corporate
races.register: cyberpunk — chrome, wet neon, corporate signage
races.attitude: The Rift is an asset class. Everything they build is instrumented, branded and depreciating.

lines: They pushed the cybernetics until the wetware answered back.
What answered was the Rift. It had been there the whole time.
By the next quarter it had a line item.
The noticing was patented within the hour.
The consciousness of the world was surveyed, valued, and depreciated
You are the equipment sent to protect the write-down.
An implant carried a signal it was never specified to carry.
The engineers called it a fault until Legal called it an opportunity.
You are standing inside the fault.

regions.name: The Interred Ground
regions.blurb: Somebody has been dying here longer than anyone has been arriving.

regions.name: Salvage Deck
regions.blurb: Plating and hull. Whatever this was, it was built to go somewhere.
